channel.title: The Hockey News - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Hockey News (thehockeynews.com)

item.title: The Hockey News Big Show At The Games: USA, Canada To Meet In Olympic Women's Hockey Final
item.description: Andrew McInnis, Michael Augello, Chris Sinclair and Ryan Kennedy react to Team USA and Canada's semifinal wins before previewing the highly anticipated medal day.

item.title: 'We Are A City In Mourning': Pawtucket Mayor, Hockey Teams And More React To Shooting Inside Ice Rink
item.description: The Boston and Providence Bruins, Boston Fleet, Pawtucket mayor Don Grebien and more local and Rhode Island state leaders shared condolences with the victims and everyone affected by a shooting during a high-school hockey game on Monday.

item.title: Three Potential NHL Landing Spots For Jeff Skinner
item.description: The San Jose Sharks placed forward Jeff Skinner on unconditional waivers for the purposes of contract termination on Monday. Which NHL teams could make sense as landing spots for the veteran forward?

item.title: Don Cherry Appointed To Order Of Ontario, Province's Highest Civilian Honor
item.description: Longtime "Coach's Corner" analyst and former NHL coach Don Cherry was appointed to the Order of Ontario alongside 29 other individuals, including Maple Leaf Sports & Entertainment chair Edward Rogers.

item.title: NHL Rumor Roundup: Devils Seek A Hockey Trade; Nazem Kadri Remains Linked To The Canadiens
item.description: The New Jersey Devils could attempt a player-for-player move to shake up their roster. Meanwhile, trade rumors persist linking Calgary Flames center Nazem Kadri to the Montreal Canadiens.

item.title: 'He's Carrying Us Right Now': Avalanche Star Martin Necas Powers Czechia At Olympics
item.description: Martin Necas is Czechia's difference-maker as they advance to the Olympic quarterfinal against Canada. His NHL opponents and Czech teammates know exactly how he thrives.

item.title: 'We Let Them Win The First Game': Czechia Seek To Eliminate Canada In Olympic Rematch
item.description: Czechia lost 5-0 to Canada in their first game of the Olympics. Although Martin Necas joked that Czechia let Canada win that game, they know they'll need to play close to perfect to avoid it happening again.

item.title: Olympic Men's Hockey: How Finland Rebounded Brilliantly From Loss To Slovakia
item.description: Team Finland has overcome an early upset in the 2026 Winter Olympics to finish strong in round-robin play. Who has stepped up for the Finns?

item.title: The Hockey News Big Show Live At The Games: Men's Qualification Playoff Round Results And Reactions
item.description: Join the chat as Michael Traikos, Andrew McInnis and Michael Augello go live to recap the men's hockey Olympic qualification playoff round.

item.title: Olympic Men's Hockey: Predicting Each Quarterfinal Matchup
item.description: The Olympic men's hockey quarterfinals are now set, and we're making our predictions for the four matches on Wednesday. Who will win – and will there be any upsets?
